# flaggr_environment (Resource)

Manages a Flaggr project environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "flaggr_environment" "qa" {
  project_id  = flaggr_project.platform.id
  slug        = "qa"
  name        = "QA"
  description = "Pre-release testing"
  color       = "#10b981"
  order       = 30
}

# In a protected environment that requires approval, flag changes go through
# change requests: manage its flags in the Flaggr dashboard (see flaggr_flag).
resource "flaggr_environment" "production_eu" {
  project_id            = flaggr_project.platform.id
  slug                  = "production-eu"
  name                  = "Production (EU)"
  order                 = 90
  protected_environment = true
  require_approval      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `slug` (String) Environment slug (used as the environment value on flags).

### Optional

- `color` (String) Hex color for UI (e.g., #3b82f6). Flaggr can't clear a color: without it in the configuration, the environment keeps the color it has, if any.
- `description` (String) Environment description. Without it in the configuration, an apply clears the environment's description, including one set outside Terraform.
- `order` (Number) Pipeline order (lower = earlier in pipeline).
- `protected_environment` (Boolean) Whether this is a protected environment.
- `require_approval` (Boolean) Whether promotions to this environment require approval.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is a default environment (read-only).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = flaggr_environment.qa
  id = "your-project-id:qa"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Environments are imported by "projectId:slug".
terraform import flaggr_environment.qa "your-project-id:qa"
```
